items.title: Esther Dupuy Breckenridge Interview, 1958-05-14
items.q: She had a concert of Gershwin, and she was a Gershwin exponent.

ctx.x: When can you remember his daughter having guys ran to the house or they used to...

Well, my father didn't necessarily have them. He just... He knew that we liked this group of Peron, and we had a crowd that would meet every Saturday and Sunday. He didn't actually ask them to come to the house, but he was interested when they were there. And if he was home, he was a doctor and was out of great deal. But whenever he was there, he listened very attentively to them and often had conversation with them on their different ideas of jazz because he was such a gifted pianist himself. And my sister was a…
It's jazz, but not New Orleans.
